A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we show that adversarial robustness is not just a problem with models, but also with data.
label noise is an important factor for adversarial vulnerability of deep learning models, however, it is not the only factor.
label noise is a cause for adversarial vulnerability of deep neural networks, but it is not the only cause.
The main takeaway from our work is that
adversarial attacks can be seen as an amplification of label noise, and that robustness is not a property of the model, but rather a property of both the model and the data.
adversarial vulnerability is not just a model training issue, and that it is crucial to also look at the data, and the representation learning process, to understand it.
